page.layout: One printed page: running head with page number at top left, heading centred above an engraving (emblem picture of a skeleton blowing smoke from a pipe, with a hanging pot above its head); below the engraving a four-line verse in italic, centred; signature mark at lower right.

main_text.head: HOMO DISCVTITVR ut fumus.
main_text.l: [engraving: skeleton emblem, not transcribed as text]
In ventos mordax fumus dispergitur; atq;
Præterit, vt nunquam forte fuisse putes.
Non secus hic transit cunctorum vita caduca,
Vt ceu non fuerit præteriisse rere.

page.notes: The head line "HOMO DISCVTITVR" is set in large capitals with "ut fumus." beneath in italic; the upper line carries "EMBLEMA" in small capitals above it. The signature at lower right reads as printed "Dij" and is uncertain: [?]. The engraving is an emblem picture of a skeleton with a pipe and a smoking vessel, with a landscape behind; it is described, not transcribed.
